title: Carney has 'good conversation' with Trump on future of Canada-U.S. trade as midterms near
summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he's had a "good conversation" with U.S. President Donald Trump on the future of Canada-U.S. trade, further adding their chat "builds on our recent constructive…

image.caption: U.S. President Donald Trump, left, speaks with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney at a working lunch in Evian-les-Bains, France, on June 16. (Evelyn Hockstein/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he's had a "good conversation" with U.S. President Donald Trump on the future of Canada-U.S. trade, further adding their chat "builds on our recent constructive discussions" over the outlines of a possible trade deal.
PM says teams will work in coming weeks to deliver 'mutually beneficial trade deal'
"Our teams will now be working in the coming weeks to deliver that outcome," Carney said on social media Sunday morning.
